items.headline: Albemarle (ALB) Stock Gets Fair Value Trim As Analysts Turn More Cautious

items.headline: the call: Thursday 8 October | head to head
items.snippet: Albemarle is highly leveraged to the lithium price; management models EBITDA of about $1B at $10, $2.5B at $20 and $4B at $30.

items.headline: Albemarle price target lowered to $135 from $230 at Argus
items.snippet: Argus lowered the firm's price target on Albemarle to $135 from $230 and keeps a Buy rating on the shares. Lithium price is up about 67% year over year, still well below all-time highs; supply and demand trends appear poised to improve into 2027.

items.headline: Albemarle price target lowered to $175 from $200 at BMO Capital
items.snippet: BMO lowered its price target on Albemarle to $175 from $200 and keeps an Outperform rating, citing recent lithium spot price weakness, while viewing the group as oversold.

items.headline: Albemarle Q2 2026 Earnings Call Transcript
items.snippet: Lithium demand is up 45% through May, driven by stationary storage. Management emphasized a tight lithium market, with supply lagging demand; 2026 outlook maintained at the high end of scenario ranges.
